title: Manglefeet
html:
Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous

Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous is the boss of Mutant Mania, currently the newest and highest level dungeon in the game (Build 150). He is a strange construct pretty much unlike anything else in the game, sort of a twisted and enhanced Mutant Hulk with bits of several other creatures.

His principal weapon (with obvious references to WWE) is a big folding chair. It will do massive damage and one swing of the chair can take out the strongest characters.

For tips on fighting Manglefeet, see Manglefeet Boss Guide.

The chest in this lair can roll a short list of named rainbows. That named roll starts at 80. There is no maximum. Those pieces are on Boss Lair Rainbows.
